notes: Topline: mid-market e-commerce marketplace (verticals: apparel + home goods) looking to replace hybrid ES+Pinecone setup with unified serving to reduce cost-per-query and improve rerank relevance. Catalog ~12M SKUs, active variations create ~24M distinct documents after normalization. Peak: 5-6x baseline during seasonal events (Black Friday windows). Current stack: ElasticSearch for metadata + Pinecone for vectors, ranking done in-app with hosted LLM calls (avg total cost ~ $0.007/query). Goal: end-to-end cost <= $0.003/query at baseline (including embedding + rerank) and P95 end-to-end search latency < 120ms for logged-in shoppers. Strong preference for predictable billing (dedicated) to avoid surprise spike charges.
use_case_summary: Semantic product search + post-retrieval neural reranking. Primary flows: homepage search, category refinements, promoted result reranks. Need fast embedding nearest-neighbor + compact rerank model for top-50 candidates. Care about index size, shard distribution, cold-cache startup for burst traffic.
